function.name: get_governance_kpis
function.description: Get governance KPIs: events today, blocked today, active developers today, blocks month-to-date, and estimated risk avoided in USD (MTD)

function.name: get_framework_coverage
function.description: Get installed compliance framework packs (SOC2, OWASP, HIPAA, PCI_DSS, etc.) with rule counts per framework

function.name: get_recent_governance_events
function.description: Get the most recent governance audit events with decision, rule_id, ai_tool, and user_email

limit.description: Number of events to return, default 15, max 100

decision.description: Filter by decision: blocked | warned | audited | allowed

since.description: ISO-8601 start timestamp, e.g. 2026-07-17T00:00:00Z for today

function.name: search_knowledge
function.description: Semantic search across Guard knowledge — use for intent-based governance questions like 'blocks related to secrets' or 'rules covering bash'
